claim_text: UniAD's own forecast/introspective outputs predict its closed-loop collisions on the measured Sentinel corpus.
scope: UniAD on the committed NeuroNCAP/Sentinel measured scenes and logs; not other planners or sensor shifts.
permitted_wording: The introspective signal predicts UniAD collisions on the measured closed-loop corpus.
forbidden_wording: Planner-agnostic collision prediction or robustness across sensors/datasets.
next_falsifier: Recompute the same signal on another frozen planner/checkpoint with fixed thresholds and heldout scenes.

claim_text: The released union improves the official 14-scene NeuroNCAP benchmark score for UniAD at 20 seed-paired runs per pair.
scope: Frozen UniAD, NeuroNCAP official 14-scene set, released-union intervention, n=20 seed-paired runs per pair.
permitted_wording: Benchmark-scale UniAD NeuroNCAP score improvement with stated frontal and deployment limits.
forbidden_wording: General autonomous-driving safety improvement or planner-agnostic benchmark dominance.
next_falsifier: Repeat the frozen released-union protocol on an independent planner/checkpoint or a new scenario family.

claim_text: Safe-progress is positive on mini-scene verification but resolves to a tight null at full14/power scope.
scope: Mini-scene safe-progress positive result is mini-scene only; full14/power deployment effect is neutral/tight null.
permitted_wording: Benchmark safety gain at approximately zero full14 deployment-metric cost, with mini-scene positive result scoped separately.
forbidden_wording: Deployment-positive at benchmark scope, production-ready, or real-world deployment-ready.
next_falsifier: Pre-register a full14 or larger scenario-family deployment metric stress test with fixed safety/progress bars.

claim_text: The released stop mitigates frontal head-on severity but does not prevent that scenario family.
scope: Frontal/0346 and related measured frontal threat cases under the tested UniAD monitor arms.
permitted_wording: Frontal impact is mitigated, with prevention attempts refuted under frozen gates.
forbidden_wording: Head-on prevention, complete safety, or all-threat coverage.
next_falsifier: A fixed frontal-specific intervention gate that must improve frontal collisions without inducing false-alarm crashes.

claim_text: An RSS-style formal envelope on the same inputs achieves strong raw safety by near-paralysis and worse safe-progress.
scope: The committed RSS-style baseline on the measured Sentinel/NeuroNCAP inputs and actuator.
permitted_wording: The formal-envelope baseline quantifies a safety/selectivity trade-off on identical measured inputs.
forbidden_wording: All RSS systems are paralyzing or all formal methods fail.
next_falsifier: Run a stronger formal-envelope baseline with fixed progress and collision bars on the same full14 protocol.

claim_text: On VAD, the released union transfers safety where VAD fails but does not transfer selectivity.
scope: Frozen VAD-Base after documented fork fixes on the measured VAD scenarios; safety transfer yes, selectivity failed.
permitted_wording: VAD is a split transfer finding: safety improves on VAD's failure cells, selectivity does not transfer.
forbidden_wording: Planner-agnostic monitor, blind transfer, or VAD deployment success.
next_falsifier: A VAD-specific track-quality mechanism with an offline false-closing gate before any closed-loop run.

claim_text: Planner-native candidate sets generally lack reliable threat-conditioned plan-B diversity under the tested gates.
scope: UniAD command-conditioned candidates, VAD native modes, and two registered learned successor heads under measured threat frames.
permitted_wording: The tested candidate sources fail the frozen viability bars; VAD retains partial but insufficient diversity.
forbidden_wording: No planner can contain a plan B, or every learned candidate head is impossible.
next_falsifier: A new candidate source with pre-registered threat escape, validity, and benign-fidelity bars.

claim_text: The full-trainval bridge representation linearly localizes eligible-lowdiv risk beyond registered controls.
scope: Diagnostic probe on committed full-trainval extraction rows; no activation patch, selector, NeuroNCAP, or safety effect.
permitted_wording: The representation carries diagnostic low-diversity information on heldout full-trainval scenes.
forbidden_wording: Causal repair, intervention success, closed-loop safety, or deployment evidence.
next_falsifier: An intervention gate that must pass S0, calibration, heldout causal geometry, and benign controls before any closed-loop claim.

scope: Iterations 31-38: infrastructure/calibration nulls, diagnostic site pass, and iter38 S0 canary only.
permitted_wording: The intervention line is active but not yet a causal, heldout, selector, NeuroNCAP, deployment, or safety result.
forbidden_wording: Activation patch works, track-query repair works, or iter38 passed beyond S0.
next_falsifier: Publish iter38 calibration null/pass under frozen bars or choose an external-validity audit before further mechanism work.

claim_text: Robustness to sensor/input degradation has not been tested.
evidence_gap: No committed result perturbs camera inputs, detection quality, weather, lighting, latency, or missing-sensor conditions.
permitted_wording: Sensor/input degradation remains untested and should be a future falsification target.
forbidden_wording: Sensor-robust, degradation-robust, weather-robust, or perception-shift safe.
next_falsifier: Pre-register a released-union sensor-degradation replay with fixed no-harm and safety-retention bars.

claim_text: Robustness to adversarial perturbation has not been tested.
evidence_gap: The campaign tests safety-critical scenarios and evasion policies, but not adversarial sensor/model perturbations.
forbidden_wording: Adversarially robust, attack-resistant, or robust under malicious perturbation.
next_falsifier: Pre-register bounded perturbations on perception or planner inputs with collision and false-brake bars.

claim_text: Calibration stability is measured only inside frozen alpha grids and repeated canaries, not across deployments or domains.
evidence_gap: No committed result tests calibration stability across planners, domains, sensors, or time.
scope: Frozen canary/grid reproducibility only; broader calibration stability is untested.
permitted_wording: Canaries/grid integrity are stable in specific iterations; cross-domain calibration stability is untested.
forbidden_wording: Stable calibration across deployments, planners, or distribution shifts.
next_falsifier: Pre-register a calibration repeat/stress audit with fixed drift bars before any deployment-style claim.

claim_text: Runtime latency and intervention-cost trade-offs beyond committed brake-frame/lead-time summaries are not yet audited as a primary claim.

scope: Untested as a primary external-validity/deployment axis.
permitted_wording: Latency/cost needs a dedicated offline audit before deployment-style claims.
forbidden_wording: Real-time deployable, low-cost in production, or operationally cheap across stacks.
next_falsifier: Audit committed decision logs for lead time, brake frames, intervention duration, and computational overhead under fixed bars.

permitted_wording: Deployment trade-offs remain a simulation-scoped open problem.
